description: Find companies covered by Annalist by name, ticker, SEC CIK or id, optionally filtered by country. Returns each company's id (used by the other tools), identifiers, sources and latest snapshot.

country.description: ISO 3166 country code, for example US, GB, ID, HK or JP

query.description: part of a name, ticker, CIK or id; leave empty to list all

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
